PREFIX='greedy-public-interop/'
CHUNK=4096
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def require(v,r):
 if not v:raise ValueError(r)
require(not ARCHIVE.exists(),'fresh immutable archive')
report=json.loads((CAPTURE/'evidence.json').read_text());require(report['status']=='passed','finished capture')
files=sorted(p for p in CAPTURE.rglob('*') if p.is_file())

index={};chunks=set();raw=0;unique_bytes=0
with tarfile.open(ARCHIVE,'w:gz',compresslevel=9) as archive:
 def add(name,data,mode=0o644):
  header=tarfile.TarInfo(PREFIX+name);header.size=len(data);header.mode=mode;header.mtime=0
  archive.addfile(header,io.BytesIO(data))
 for i,path in enumerate(files):
  parts=[];digest=hashlib.sha256();size=0
  with path.open('rb') as stream:
   while block:=stream.read(CHUNK):
    key=sha(block);parts.append(key);digest.update(block);size+=len(block)
    if key not in chunks:
     add('chunks/'+key+'.bin',block);chunks.add(key);unique_bytes+=len(block)
  index['capture/'+str(path.relative_to(CAPTURE))]={'bytes':size,'sha256':digest.hexdigest(),'chunks':parts,'mode':path.stat().st_mode&0o777}
  raw+=size
  if (i+1)%3000==0:print(i+1,'/',len(files),'unique bytes',unique_bytes,flush=True)
 data=(json.dumps(index,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode();add('file-map.json',data)
 metadata={'schema_version':1,'chunk_bytes':CHUNK,'files':len(files),'raw_bytes':raw,'unique_chunks':len(chunks),'unique_bytes':unique_bytes,'file_map_sha256':sha(data),'capture_evidence_sha256':sha((CAPTURE/'evidence.json').read_bytes()),'qualification':'All files from the completed capture, including binary responses, requests, objects and Rust build outputs. Downloaded C sources remain external. Reconstruction source is for manual use, not executed by an audit.'}
 add('report.json',(json.dumps(metadata,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
 # Standalone reconstruction is a convenience only; callers must review it.
 source='''from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('destination',type=Path);a=p.parse_args()
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if a.destination.exists() or a.destination.is_symlink():raise ValueError('fresh destination required')
files=json.loads((root/'file-map.json').read_text())
a.destination.mkdir(parents=True)
for name,item in files.items():
 relative=Path(name)
 if relative.is_absolute() or '..' in relative.parts:raise ValueError('relative file name required')
 destination=a.destination/relative;destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 digest=hashlib.sha256();size=0
 with destination.open('xb') as out:
  for key in item['chunks']:
   if len(key)!=64 or any(c not in '0123456789abcdef' for c in key):raise ValueError('chunk key')
   data=(root/'chunks'/(key+'.bin')).read_bytes()
   if len(data)>4096 or hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!=key:raise ValueError('chunk identity')
   out.write(data);digest.update(data);size+=len(data)
 if size!=item['bytes'] or digest.hexdigest()!=item['sha256']:raise ValueError('file identity')
 destination.chmod(item['mode'])
'''
 add('reconstruct.py',source.encode())
# Independently read archive members; never execute the archived reconstruction.
with tarfile.open(ARCHIVE) as archive:
 members={m.name:m for m in archive.getmembers()}
 require(len(members)==len(chunks)+3,'exact regular archive inventory')
 require(all(m.isfile() for m in members.values()),'no archive links')
 restored=json.loads(archive.extractfile(PREFIX+'file-map.json').read())
 require(restored==index,'exact reconstruction index')
 cache={}
 for key in chunks:
  item=members[PREFIX+'chunks/'+key+'.bin'];require(item.size<=CHUNK,'bounded archived chunk')
  block=archive.extractfile(item).read();require(sha(block)==key,'archived chunk hash');cache[key]=block
 for name,item in restored.items():

  for key in item['chunks']:
   digest.update(cache[key]);size+=len(cache[key])
  original=CAPTURE/Path(name).relative_to('capture')
  require(size==item['bytes'] and digest.hexdigest()==item['sha256']==sha(original.read_bytes()),'complete archived file identity')
metadata.update(archive=str(ARCHIVE.relative_to(ROOT)),archive_bytes=ARCHIVE.stat().st_size,archive_sha256=sha(ARCHIVE.read_bytes()),verified_files=len(files))
Path('/tmp/zstdoxide-greedy-public-archive.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(metadata,sort_keys=True),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,tarfile
ROOT=Path('/Users/lanxingcan/Workspace/zstdoxize');CAPTURE=Path('/private/tmp/zstdoxide-greedy-public-2026-10-12')
ARCHIVE=ROOT/'docs/evidence/2026-10-12-greedy-public-interop.tar.gz';PREFIX='greedy-public-interop/'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def require(v,r):
 if not v:raise ValueError(r)
chunks={};other={};names=set()
# Gzip is sequential: avoid random member seeks, which repeatedly decompress
# earlier data. No archived program executes and no member is extracted to disk.
with tarfile.open(ARCHIVE,'r|gz') as archive:
 for item in archive:
  require(item.isfile() and item.name not in names and item.name.startswith(PREFIX),'regular unique member')
  names.add(item.name);name=item.name[len(PREFIX):]
  cap=4096 if name.startswith('chunks/') else 64<<20
  require(item.size<=cap,'bounded archive member')
  data=archive.extractfile(item).read(cap+1);require(len(data)==item.size,'exact member bytes')
  if name.startswith('chunks/'):
   key=sha(data);require(name=='chunks/'+key+'.bin','chunk name/content identity');chunks[key]=data
  else:other[name]=data
require(set(other)=={'file-map.json','report.json','reconstruct.py'},'exact metadata inventory')
files=json.loads(other['file-map.json']);report=json.loads(other['report.json'])
require(report['file_map_sha256']==sha(other['file-map.json']),'index identity')
actual={str(p.relative_to(CAPTURE)):p for p in CAPTURE.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
require(set(files)=={'capture/'+n for n in actual},'complete capture inventory')
raw=0;used=set()
for name,item in files.items():
 digest=hashlib.sha256();size=0
 for key in item['chunks']:
  used.add(key);block=chunks[key];size+=len(block);digest.update(block)
 path=actual[name[len('capture/'):]]
 original=hashlib.sha256()
 with path.open('rb') as stream:
  while block:=stream.read(1<<20):original.update(block)
 require(not path.is_symlink() and size==item['bytes']==path.stat().st_size
         and digest.hexdigest()==item['sha256']==original.hexdigest()
         and item['mode']==path.stat().st_mode&0o777,'exact reconstructed capture file')
 raw+=size
require(used==set(chunks) and raw==report['raw_bytes'] and len(files)==report['files'],'no unused or missing data')
require(len(chunks)==report['unique_chunks'] and sum(map(len,chunks.values()))==report['unique_bytes'],'chunk totals')
report.update(archive=str(ARCHIVE.relative_to(ROOT)),archive_bytes=ARCHIVE.stat().st_size,archive_sha256=sha(ARCHIVE.read_bytes()),verified_files=len(files),archive_members=len(names),verification='Sequential read of every member and every reconstructed file compared with the unchanged complete capture; no archived code executed.')
Path('/tmp/zstdoxide-greedy-public-archive.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
